title: @optimization_log (FG.3 minimal-build) + @transfer (FG.2 NO-BUILD) — the agent-handoff annotation pair
r2_note: Surgical revision of r1 (optimistic APPROVE; pessimistic NEEDS_REVISION: 3 must-fix + 5 should-fix, all spec-level). The two per-half decisions (FG.3 minimal-build / FG.2 NO-BUILD) and the byte-identical-SPIR-V oracle are UNCHANGED — confirmed sound. Changes are grammar/schema tightening only.

FG.3_optimization_log.rationale: The external JSONL history (M2.4) is keyed by xxh3(source-bytes) via history_path_for_source, so it ORPHANS on every rewrite — the exact operation the agent loop performs. Verified: .pipeline/history/ holds only .gitkeep. Embedding the log in source makes the kernel self-describing across rewrites — a concrete, falsifiable value case that clears the M3.10b bar. Minimal = read+validate+round-trip first-class block + ONE writer (axc log-opt CLI + thin MCP wrapper); codegen-inert (byte-identical SPIR-V golden gate).
FG.3_optimization_log.cheap_alternative_weighed_r2: JSONL-rekey-by-stable-identity (~50 LOC) is weighed in spec §0.5: embedding wins on survives-move/rename + zero side-channel + inline-visible-to-any-reader; the rekey is a COMPLEMENTARY future fix (machine archive), not a substitute. Not asserted strictly-better — costs source bytes + merge noise, stated honestly.
FG.3_optimization_log.writer: axc log-opt <src.axc> (LLM-free, CI-runnable) + append_optimization_log MCP tool; ingests rewrite_verify::VerifyReport / grid_search::HistoryEntryRecord via --from-verify/--from-grid; source-preserving span splice; FAIL-CLOSED at MAX_OPT_LOG_ENTRIES (LogOptError::Full) and on multi-kernel (LogOptError::Multikernel) — never emits an uncompilable file.
FG.3_optimization_log.reader: Minimal = block round-trips error-free through lex/compile/HIR/rewrite-verify (byte-verbatim through the M3.16 rewrite flow, AT-2925) and is visible inline to agents reading the .axc; the merged embedded+JSONL reader is DEFERRED.

FG.2_transfer.class: paper finding (spec+verdict), M3.10b / M3.13-PRONG-B class, AT-2915..2918
FG.2_transfer.rationale: No consumer exists today: the 7 MCP tools none read an in-source handoff block; the 7-agent supervisor routes via external .pipeline/runs/*.json; the autotuner reads @strategy. A confidence-scored handoff PROTOCOL with nothing acting on the score is speculative. Unlike FG.3 there is no verified weakness it repairs and no demonstrated producer demand. @transfer remains rejected as UnknownAnnotationInM0; no parser/AST/HIR/codegen change.
FG.2_transfer.revisit_trigger: Build @transfer (validate-and-preserve first, then protocol) when a concrete consumer is specified: (1) an agent-orchestration MCP tool designed to READ a kernel's @transfer block to route the next optimization action, OR (2) the 7-agent supervisor changed to consume in-source @transfer handoff instead of/alongside external verdict JSON. Cheap upgrade path (~1 schema over FG.3's block grammar) documented but not taken.

must_fix_resolutions.grammar_pinned: RecordField.value is now a NEW CLOSED enum RecordValue { Str(String), Int(i64), Ident(String) } — NOT Spanned<AnnotationArg>. Formal EBNF production added (spec §1.3a): entry/version are contextual hard keywords; record_value closed to 3 scalar shapes; nesting structurally impossible; nested-record / call / hole-ref rejected AT PARSE with recovery. Reject fixtures = AT-2919 (nested/call/hole/nested-entry/typo-keyword), AT-2920 (negative-metric-per-unit + out-of-set ident), AT-2921 (two-level trailing comma).
must_fix_resolutions.writer_fail_closed_at_capacity: axc log-opt into a 64-entry block -> LogOptError::Full { current, max } (exit-coded, machine-readable), source byte-for-byte UNCHANGED, never emits the 65th uncompilable entry. Rotation DEFERRED (spec §1.8). AT-2922.
must_fix_resolutions.schema_version_forward_compat: Required block-level `version: 1` (SUPPORTED_OPT_LOG_VERSION=1). RULE (spec §1.4a): version absent/dup/non-Int/<1 -> reject; version==1 + unknown key -> REJECT (typo protection); version>1 + unknown key -> PRESERVE-AND-WARN (forward_unknown + HirWarning::UnknownOptimizationLogKeyForward), known required fields still validated; forward-compat covers ADDITIVE new keys only. Both directions tested: AT-2923 (reject) / AT-2924 (preserve-warn).

should_fix_resolutions.rekey_alternative_weighed: spec §0.5 — one honest paragraph; embedding vs JSONL-rekey, complementary not substitute.
should_fix_resolutions.design_subsection_number: ## 3.1.43 (two-hash header, next-sequential after verified ## 3.1.42 M3.16 at DESIGN.md:1421; M3.17/M3.18 added no numbered subsection). Corrects r1's 3.1.44 (skipped one).
should_fix_resolutions.verdict_vocabulary_cited: OptLogVerdict = the SIX rewrite_verify::Verdict variants verbatim in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE {PASS,FAIL,REJECT,SKIPPED,NONDETERMINISTIC_ORACLE,ERROR} (verified rewrite_verify.rs:151-157, #[serde(rename_all=SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE)], 6-variant enum) + grid-only REGRESS. Ident is NONDETERMINISTIC_ORACLE (not r1's NONDETERMINISTIC); no Regress in rewrite_verify; no M3.17/M3.18 verdict additions. Exhaustive 1:1 mapping table (spec §1.5) + AT-2907 strengthened over all six.
should_fix_resolutions.round_trip_strengthened: AT-2925 — block (incl. forward_unknown keys) survives the M3.16 rewrite-flow BYTE-VERBATIM, not merely accepted.
should_fix_resolutions.ts_reproducibility: Default now() documented non-reproducible & production-only; explicit --ts MANDATORY in every AT fixture; MCP wrapper inherits the rule (spec §1.5, §7.1).

optimistic_minor_resolutions.metric_milli_unit_semantics: Frozen unit vocabulary {mtflops, pct_milli, ns, us, ms, bytes}: the _milli scaling lives in the UNIT NAME, not the field name. mtflops = TFLOPS*1000, pct_milli = %*1000 (milli-scaled, sub-integer precision); ns/us/ms/bytes = RAW integers. Field renamed metric_milli -> metric (unit-neutral). Per-unit sign rule: mtflops/ns/us/ms/bytes require metric>=0 (reject <0); pct_milli signed (deltas allowed).
optimistic_minor_resolutions.verdict_variant_count_slip: Corrected 'adopt verbatim (7 values)' -> the enum is SIX variants (spec §7.2).
optimistic_minor_resolutions.log_opt_no_lock: Documented last-writer-wins + loud stderr note; --force/lock deferred (unchanged from r1).

version_rule.out_of_scope: A future version changing an existing field's value-set/type is a breaking change; v1 still validates known fields by v1 rules (forward-compat covers additive new keys only)
